text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Another shipload of 29,162 tonnes of wheat arrive at Umm Qasr port.
- Deputy Prime Minister Tareq Aziz meets visiting Turkish state minister.
- Rebels of the Patriotic Union of Kurdistan led by Jalal Talabani steal fuel provided to Kurdish areas by the central government.
- Iraq urges the U.N. Security Council to end trade sanctions imposed on it after its 1991 invasion of Kuwait.
- Legislative Council of the Kurdish Autonomous region starts its spring session.
(The above were also carried by THAWRA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Iraqi experts in irrigation are heading for Sudan.
- Jordanian minister of labour meets in Amman with Iraqi ambassador.
